title: Google Ads Misrepresentation — misleading ad design
excerpts: Inconsistencies between the ad and the landing page/app.
summary: Google identifies ad-to-destination inconsistencies as a misleading-ad-design concern. Paraphrase.

title: Google Ads Misrepresentation — unreliable claims
excerpts: Making inaccurate claims or claims that entice the user with an improbable result (even if this result is possible) as the likely outcome a user can expect is not allowed.
summary: Google prohibits inaccurate claims and certain improbable-result claims. Paraphrase.

title: Google Ads Misrepresentation — dishonest pricing practices
excerpts: Employing pricing practices that create a false or misleading impression of the cost of a product or service, leading to inflated or unexpected charges is not allowed.
summary: Google prohibits pricing practices that mislead consumers about product or service costs. Paraphrase.

title: Google Ads Editorial — capitalization
excerpts: The following is not allowed: Capitalization that isn't used correctly or for its intended purpose
summary: Google disallows capitalization that is not used correctly or for its intended purpose. Paraphrase.

title: Google Ads Destination requirements — destination mismatch
excerpts: The following would lead to disapproval for Destination mismatch: The domain or domain extension in the display URL doesn’t match the final and mobile URLs where users are taken to
summary: Google requires an ad to accurately represent the destination users reach after clicking. Paraphrase.

title: Google Ads Healthcare and medicines — prescription requirements
excerpts: Offering prescription drugs without a prescription is not allowed.
summary: Google disallows offering prescription drugs without a prescription. Paraphrase.

title: Google Ads Personalized advertising — users under 18
excerpts: Users under the age of 18 are not eligible for personalized advertising of any kind, including serving based on Predefined Google Audiences.
summary: Google excludes users under 18 from personalized advertising of any kind. Paraphrase.
